page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a printed head line at the top; a woodcut ornament below the text block; a catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: FAMÆ discrimen subit etiam luxuria, & ingratitudo. Quisque autem bene audire cupit. Exemplo est adolescens luxuriosus.
FAMA majorum virtute ante parta, non est per flagitium perdenda. Trin. 3.2.v. 16. & seqq.
OMNES famæ suæ rationem habent, ut monumentum aliquod sui post se relinquant.
NON negligendum quid alii de nobis sentiant.
RUMOR velocissimus. Si quid factum vel bene, vel perperam, per vias omnes fabulantur.
PRÆSTAT damnum ferre, quàm famæ facere jacturam.
FAMAM nostram lædi ægerrimè ferre solemus.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. The catchword "FAMI-" is set at the lower right. Some letters in the italic reference lines are uncertain, notably the numerals in "Cist. 5. 1. v. 1.", which may be read differently.
